text:
taylor: quick sync — onboarding `ark-4b-v1`.
ravi: what's the blocker?

taylor: weights landed in gs://redwood-models/ark/ark-4b/v1/ark-4b-00001.pt but config.json in the PR points to `s3://models/ark-4b/v1/ark-4b.pt`.

liz: ah that mismatch will fail the fetch in private deployments.

marco: also noticed tokenizer `pad_token_id` is missing in the config; runtime defaults to 0 which breaks our padding mask for this model.

taylor: excerpt from config in PR:
```
{
  "weight_uri": "s3://models/ark-4b/v1/ark-4b.pt",
  "max_seq_length": 2048,
  "bos_token_id": 1
}
```

ravi: can we update PR to `gs://redwood-models/ark/ark-4b/v1/ark-4b-00001.pt` and add `pad_token_id`? what should pad be?

liz: tokenizer reports special ids: bos=1 eos=2 pad=0 in the tokenizer artifact. But the tokenizer we're testing has subtoken-offsets where 0 is used for real tokens in some vocab versions — so pad=50265 would be the safe explicit ID for this tokenizer release.

marco: thanks — two action items: (1) patch config weight_uri -> gs path (2) add explicit `pad_token_id": "50265"` and include `tokenizer_version` field.

taylor: I'll push a small patch today. anyone want to run a quick serve smoke after?

deploy-bot: smoke test queued for commit c3f8a2. logs: https://ci.redwood.dev/12345

qa-bot: quick lint: config schema failure — missing `quantization` enum (allowed: none, int8, int4). mark: none if unknown.

ravi: good catch. include `quantization": "none"` in the config snippet.

liz: once patched I'll run local inference sanity (short prompt, check no truncation and that pads are masked).

taylor: thanks all — I'll update PR and ping when smoke passes. @ravi @liz @marco :thumbsup:

marco: ping me after deploy-bot completes, will validate tokenization edgecases.

deploy-bot: smoke test passed for c3f8a2 — runtime load ok, no OOM in 2-run attempts.

taylor: passing to ops for gate. final checklist: weight_uri points to gs, pad_token_id=50265, tokenizer_version tag, quantization=none, max_seq_length=2048.

ravi: approved for config-gate once PR has the three fields.

liz: noted — I'll add a short eval prompt set for regression tracking after rollout.

taylor: closing loop once PR merged. thanks!
